slides.headline: Humanity will stop growing at 10.3 billion
slides.subline: **UN projections** say the peak arrives in the 2080s.

slides.body: The UN estimated the world had about [[8.2 billion]] people in **2024**. The same report says the population will keep growing for another **50 to 60 years**.
Then it stops. The UN’s medium projection tops out near [[10.3 billion]] in the **mid-2080s**, then edges down to about **10.2 billion** by 2100.
The global fertility rate fell from **4.9 births per woman in 1950** to [[2.25]] in 2024. Replacement level is about 2.1.
One in four people live in a country whose population has [[already peaked]], the UN says. Life expectancy hit **73.3 years** in 2024.
Fewer people, longer lives. Is a shrinking world a problem or a relief? Tell us below.
